desc: Is Paper Mario 64's Jr. Troopa fair in the story? His first fight in the plaza at the story's level (Mario level 1, Goombella), normal damage, no auto battler at all: a player who only presses A now and then (the first command, Jump, and the first target each turn; an action command only by luck). He must lose: the win, Goombario joining
log_must: \[pm64\] boss version: Jr\. Troopa's first fight
\[pm64\] Goombario joins with partner 1, its boss beaten
log_must_not: \[pm64\] boss: Jr\. Troopa hits kind \d+ for ([3-9]|\d\d)
